meta.title: Edier Villaneda | Senior Software Developer
meta.description: Personal website of Edier Andrés Villaneda Navarro, Senior Software Developer specialized in IBM i, PHP, Node.js and Angular.

about.description: Systems Engineer with more than 15 years of experience in software development for the financial, healthcare and corporate sectors. Expert in IBMi (RPG ILE, COBOL/400), PHP, Node.js and Angular. Passionate about integrating legacy systems with modern technologies, process automation and software quality.
about.title: Senior Software Developer | Software Analyst Developer | IT Roles
about.summary: Senior Software Developer with a long track record in the analysis, development and maintenance of enterprise solutions.
about.details: Experienced across multiple technology stacks, from IBMi mainframe to modern frontend. UiPath-certified RPA developer with knowledge of Docker, Jenkins and DevOps practices. Focused on delivering robust, scalable, high-value solutions for the business.

facts.description: More than 18 years of continuous experience in software development, systems integration and process automation.

skills.description: More than 15 years of software development experience across multiple platforms and languages.

resume.description: Systems Engineer with more than 15 years of experience in software development for the financial, healthcare and corporate sectors. Expert in IBMi, PHP, Node.js and Angular.

highlights: Development and maintenance of enterprise IBMi / RPG ILE solutions for Leasing Bancolombia (Oct. 2022 - present), delivering improvements and resolving incidents in the leasing system's processes and data.
Development of requirements on the Matrix hospital management platform at Clínica de las Américas using PHP and Node.js (Jan. 2021 - Oct. 2022).
End-to-end certification of the Pactia platform on Azure DevOps, ensuring the quality and functional compliance of the corporate portal (Aug. 2021 - Jan. 2022).
Development of a pilot application and analysis of User Story documentation at Intersoftware with PHP (Jun. 2020 - Aug. 2021).
Development of the Managers Portal and migration of the OP platform from 4.0 to 4.2 at Votre / Leonisa using IBMi / RPG ILE (Jun. 2019 - Apr. 2020).
Management and development of COBOL/400 and COBOL ILE projects on AS/400 iSeries for the financial sector.
Integration with Visionamos through Web Services (AS/400 ↔ external server).
Development with SDA, RLU and PDM, and RPG ILE support.
Development and maintenance of Windows Services in C#.
Full lifecycle of PHP + Oracle projects: analysis, estimation, development and deployment.
Optimization of high-volume queries and reports with Oracle PL/SQL.
Implementation of Web Services, Symfony, AJAX and Git/SVN version control.
Automation with Excel macros and data mining.
Third-Party Payer Recovery project in PHP Symfony 2 + Oracle for the healthcare sector.
Web Services development and Oracle PL/SQL optimization.
Development of PHP + Oracle web applications for the EPS's critical nationwide processes.
Implementation of Web Services, PL/SQL and JavaScript frameworks.
Process automation and query optimization.
Web migration and development with PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS.
Development of the PANCE platform.
Administration of MySQL and Linux servers.
